+# PIPD-LS-SP — install (single source of truth)
+
+This page is the **install SSOT**: every other page that mentions installing PIPD-LS-SP either is
+this page or points at it. There are **two install routes and only two** — **Web** and **Agent** —
+and they have different ceilings. Pick one, read its ceiling, and do not read a green build (or a
+copied file) as anything more than what the [states table](#states-that-are-not-the-same) below says.
+
+Version pin for everything on this page: release **`v0.1.1-preview.3`**, release-tag target and
+build-source commit **`cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a`**. The authority for these facts is
+[`docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json`](../RELEASE_TUPLE.json); read it before you rely on any digest quoted
+below.
+
+---
+
+## Route 1 — Web (single-document fallback)
+
+There is **no public plugin directory listing yet**: nothing has been published to a plugin
+directory, so no user can install PIPD-LS-SP from one. The Web route today is therefore a **single
+document**, `PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md`, produced by [`tools/build_web_fallback.py`](../../tools/build_web_fallback.py)
+from a frozen mount pack. You attach that one document to a conversation or a Knowledge base; you do
+not install anything. Its ceiling is **`DOC_MOUNT_ONLY`** — no Python CLI, no MCP, no repository
+write, no S4 acceptance (spelled out [below](#the-web-fallback-document-and-its-doc_mount_only-ceiling)).
+The conditional directory route is described [further down](#the-directory-route-conditional-not-available-today).
+
+---
+
+## Route 2 — Agent (one copy-paste prompt)
+
+The Agent route is **one copy-paste prompt**: [`PIPD_AGENT_INSTALL_PROMPT.md`](PIPD_AGENT_INSTALL_PROMPT.md).
+It targets four supported hosts — **Hermes Agent**, **Codex Desktop (GUI)**, **Codex CLI** and
+**Claude Code** — and it makes the host do the work: detect its own identity/version/OS, prove its
+own discovery mechanism, show the exact paths and the diff, stop for approval, and then verify the
+load. **File presence is not evidence.** A host is only counted when it proves *real discovery* and
+an **8/8 effective load** of the eight skills, each with one positive and one negative trigger; if
+all that happened is that files were copied, the correct report is `NOT_VERIFIED`. Web GPT-6 is a
+**consumer of the fallback document, not an agent host** — it does not load the skills and is not a
+qualifying host for this route.
+
+The eight skills the route installs are the eight `skills/pipd-*` packs — `pipd-route-intake`,
+`pipd-authority-source`, `pipd-profile-tailor`, `pipd-pi-compile`, `pipd-pd-bind`,
+`pipd-execution-contract`, `pipd-assurance-tqaep`, `pipd-package-project` — six files each, **48
+files** in total.
+
+---
+
+## The Web fallback document and its `DOC_MOUNT_ONLY` ceiling
+
+`PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md` is one markdown document built from a *frozen mount pack* — a directory that
+carries its own `MANIFEST.sha256`, e.g. the checked-in
+[`dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3/`](../../dist/mount/) pack. Build it with
+the tool's own CLI:
+
+```bash
+python tools/build_web_fallback.py \
+  --mount-pack dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3 \
+  --release-id v0.1.1-preview.3 \
+  --release-commit cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a \
+  --out PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md
+```
+
+The tool is fail-closed, not best-effort. It **refuses** (typed reason, non-zero exit) instead of
+warning, on `MANIFEST_DIGEST_MISMATCH`, `MEMBER_SYMLINK`, `PATH_ESCAPE`, `UNEXPECTED_EXTRA_FILE`,
+`RELEASE_STAMP_MISSING`, `MEMBER_NOT_TEXT`, `SIZE_CAP_EXCEEDED` (it never truncates) and
+`DESTINATION_EXISTS` / `DESTINATION_SYMLINK`. It writes with `O_EXCL`, embeds no timestamp, stamps
+`DOC_MOUNT_ONLY` plus the member inventory, and is byte-deterministic across rebuilds.
+
+**The ceiling is `DOC_MOUNT_ONLY`.** That means, precisely:
+
+| not available through the fallback document | why |
+|---|---|
+| the Python **CLI** (`pipd`) | the document is content; it runs no `pipd` on the reader's machine |
+| **MCP** or any tool surface | nothing is registered and nothing is invoked |
+| **repository writing** | the document writes nothing to any checkout |
+| **S4 acceptance** | mounting a document accepts no stage, qualifies no host and approves no release |
+
+The host that consumes it is a read-only semantic surface: it can help you *design* work; it cannot
+execute, install, test, approve or release anything. For an 8/8 loaded skill set with real
+discovery, use the Agent route.
+
+---
+
+## The Directory route (conditional, not available today)
+
+A plugin directory listing is a *different* route, and it is **conditional on a published,
+account-visible listing** — one that actually exists and can be found from an account. None exists
+today. Treat every "install from the directory" instruction you read anywhere as **not available**
+until all of the following are true, and each is separately evidenced:
+
+1. the package root manifest conforms to the directory's own vendor schema (Agent Plugins 1.0), not
+   to PIPD's internal bookkeeping manifest;
+2. the directory's portal has reviewed and approved the submitted package (its own record, not ours);
+3. the listing is published and account-visible, and the bytes it serves match the receipt digest.
+
+Until then the Web route is exactly the single document in Route 1. Do not present a conditional
+route as an available one.
+
+---
+
+## States that are NOT the same
+
+These five words are kept apart on purpose. None of them is upgraded by a green build, and the
+right-hand column is what would have to exist for the word to be true — **not** what exists now.
+
+| state | meaning | required evidence | state today |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| `BUILD_PASS` | the deterministic packager built the candidate and its own tests are green | the build tool exits `0` with a byte-identical rebuild (two builds, same input, same bytes), the two upgrade test modules plus the full suite green, and a receipt whose `claim_ceiling` is `LOCAL_PACKAGER_PASS_ONLY` | **NOT claimed** — the builder *refuses* on the deliberately absent owner inputs (`derivations.json` is empty, no pinned publisher identity, no pinned official/vendor schema digest, no icon), so no candidate ZIP is claimed |
+| `PORTAL_APPROVED` | the plugin directory's own review approved the submitted package | the portal's approval record / identifier for that submission — the directory's verdict, never our own summary | **NOT_EXECUTED** — the manifest records `official_portal_verification: NOT_EXECUTED`; no submission was reviewed |
+| `PUBLISHED` | the package is live in the public directory and its served bytes are the ones we hashed | a published, account-visible listing **plus** the served asset's digest agreeing with the receipt | **NOT_PUBLISHED** — no public directory listing exists yet |
+| `HOST_QUALIFIED` | a specific host really loads the eight skills | per-host, host-produced evidence: the host resolved the project root, really discovered the skills, reported **8/8 effective load**, and passed one positive and one negative trigger; raw logs attached | **NOT_VERIFIED** — no host has produced that evidence; a copied file reports `NOT_VERIFIED` |
+| `S4_FULL_PASS` | the S0–S4 challenge is accepted as a *full* pass | independent verifier receipts covering the whole S0–S4 challenge, not scoped receipts | **NOT claimed** — the challenge is `PARTIAL_CHALLENGE`; scoped receipts only, and `G-RELEASE_FULL_PASS` is not granted |
+
+`BUILD_PASS` != `PORTAL_APPROVED` != `PUBLISHED` != `HOST_QUALIFIED` != `S4_FULL_PASS`. A green
+`BUILD_PASS` on this repository does **not** imply any of the other four — and there is no `BUILD_PASS`
+today either.
+
+---
+
+## Advanced and recovery
+
+Everything below is subordinate to the two routes above. It is not an alternative route.
+
+### Version pin
+
+Pin the **immutable** identity, never a moving branch tip:
+
+- release id **`v0.1.1-preview.3`**; release-tag target **`cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a`**.
+- authoritative record: [`docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json`](../RELEASE_TUPLE.json).
+- **Known open item, stated rather than hidden:** the immutable `v0.1.1-preview.3` **tag** still
+  holds the pre-correction pack, so a rebuild *from the tag's tree* does not reproduce the currently
+  served asset. The served asset was corrected in place and is reproducible from this tree
+  (`docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json` → `authority_note`). Closing that needs a new immutable preview, not
+  another in-place replacement — it is a Release Owner item and it is **not closed**.
+
+### Hashes
+
+- Wheel `pipd_ls_sp-0.1.1a3-py3-none-any.whl`: the published digest is recorded in the repository
+  front page (`README.md`). Verify the bytes you downloaded against that digest before installing;
+  this page does not replace the sidecar.
+- Mount pack ZIP `PIPD-LS-SP_S4_WEB_MOUNT_v0.1.1-preview.3.zip`: digest recorded in
+  `docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json` (`published_asset_sha256`), with a `.sha256` sidecar next to the ZIP.
+- Inside an unpacked pack, `MANIFEST.sha256` lists every member's sha256 (LF-normalised text bytes
+  hash as stored). `tools/build_web_fallback.py` recomputes it and refuses on any mismatch.
+
+### Uninstall / rollback
+
+- **Web fallback:** delete `PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md`, and detach it from the conversation or Knowledge
+  base. Nothing was installed, so nothing else changes.
+- **Agent route:** remove exactly the files the prompt listed in its *uninstall path* line before it
+  wrote anything — the prompt refuses to run without printing that path first, and it refuses global
+  writes, so removal is confined to the project-local skill directory. Re-run the prompt to see the
+  list again; do not delete files it did not name.
+- **Wheel (CLI):** inside the virtual environment you installed into,
+  `python -m pip uninstall pipd-ls-sp`; or delete that environment. Nothing is installed outside it.
+
+### Reporting a failure
+
+Report what the host or the tool actually produced, not a summary of what you hoped for. Include:
+
+- host, OS and host version, and the shell/file/network permissions the host declared;
+- the pinned source you used (repo URL + the 40-hex commit, and the pack ZIP digest if you used one);
+- the **effective** skill count (discovered and loaded, not files copied);
+- every refusal case you hit, with the tool's or host's typed reason, verbatim;
+- the raw log paths.
+
+This repository's own read-only gate for the upgrade is
+[`.github/workflows/public-plugin-verify.yml`](../../.github/workflows/public-plugin-verify.yml); it
+uploads its raw logs as the `public-plugin-verify-raw-logs` artifact, which is the shape a failure
+report should have. A failure report is never an acceptance claim: see the
+[states table](#states-that-are-not-the-same) — none of those five words is granted by reporting.

+name: public-plugin-verify
+
+# Read-only verification of the S4POST Stage B upgrade (the public-plugin projection, the web
+# fallback and the install routes). It grants nothing: a green run here is NOT a portal approval,
+# NOT a publication, NOT a host qualification and NOT an S4 acceptance — see
+# docs/install/README.md, "States that are NOT the same".
+#
+# Triggers are pull_request (restricted to the upgrade paths) and workflow_dispatch only. There is
+# deliberately no `pull_request_target`, no `secrets.*`, no repository write, no tag and no publish
+# step. Because `pull_request` from a fork gets a read-only token, no step tries to write anything
+# back to the repository.
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - ".github/workflows/public-plugin-verify.yml"
+      - "README.md"
+      - "docs/install/**"
+      - "docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json"
+      - "packaging/public-plugin/**"
+      - "tools/freeze_public_plugin_source.py"
+      - "tools/build_public_plugin.py"
+      - "tools/build_web_fallback.py"
+      - "tests/test_public_plugin_packaging.py"
+      - "tests/test_web_fallback.py"
+      - "dist/mount/**"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: public-plugin-verify-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out the frozen subject
+        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          # full history + tags: the release-identity gate re-derives the release tags with
+          # `git rev-parse <tag>^{commit}`, and the "wrote no frozen path" step needs the base sha.
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Set up Python 3.11
+        uses: actions/setup-python@0b93645e9fea7318ecaed2b359559ac225c90a2b  # v5.3.0
+        with:
+          python-version: "3.11"
+
+      - name: Prove the upgrade wrote no skills/**, src/** or schemas/**
+        env:
+          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          BASE="${PR_BASE_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)}"
+          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE" HEAD
+          CHANGED="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE"...HEAD)"
+          printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED"
+          if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | grep -Eq '^(skills|src|schemas)/'; then
+            echo "UPGRADE_WROTE_FROZEN_PATH: this upgrade must not write skills/, src/ or schemas/:" >&2
+            printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | grep -E '^(skills|src|schemas)/' >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "NO_FROZEN_PATH_WRITTEN"
+
+      - name: Compile the three upgrade tools
+        # Nothing is installed for this step: the three tools import the standard library only.
+        run: |
+          python -m py_compile \
+            tools/freeze_public_plugin_source.py \
+            tools/build_public_plugin.py \
+            tools/build_web_fallback.py
+          echo "PY_COMPILE_OK"
+
+      - name: Assert the upgrade is stdlib-only (no third-party import)
+        # WHY THERE IS NO `pip install -r <file>` FOR THE UPGRADE IN THIS WORKFLOW: the three tools
+        # and the two new test modules import the standard library only, so there is no requirements
+        # file for them to pull — none exists. This step enforces that claim fail-closed, so a later
+        # third-party import fails the gate instead of silently needing a dependency.
+        run: |
+          python - <<'PY'
+          import ast
+          import sys
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          TARGETS = (
+              "tools/freeze_public_plugin_source.py",
+              "tools/build_public_plugin.py",
+              "tools/build_web_fallback.py",
+              "tests/test_public_plugin_packaging.py",
+              "tests/test_web_fallback.py",
+          )
+          # The repository's own modules plus its package/test roots are not third-party.
+          OWN = {
+              "tools", "tests",
+              "freeze_public_plugin_source", "build_public_plugin", "build_web_fallback",
+              "pipd_ls_sp",
+          }
+          stdlib = set(sys.stdlib_module_names)
+          offenders = []
+          for rel in TARGETS:
+              path = Path(rel)
+              if not path.is_file():
+                  offenders.append(f"{rel}: MISSING (the upgrade is incomplete)")
+                  continue
+              tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=rel)
+              for node in ast.walk(tree):
+                  if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+                      roots = [alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names]
+                  elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0 and node.module:
+                      roots = [node.module.split(".")[0]]
+                  else:
+                      continue
+                  for root in roots:
+                      if root not in stdlib and root not in OWN:
+                          offenders.append(f"{rel}: {root}")
+          if offenders:
+              print("NON_STDLIB_IMPORT:")
+              for entry in offenders:
+                  print(f"  {entry}")
+              raise SystemExit(1)
+          print("STDLIB_ONLY_OK")
+          PY
+
+      - name: The two new test modules pass with no third-party dependency installed
+        # Almost the strictest form of "the upgrade pulls no requirement": this runs BEFORE anything
+        # is installed, so a third-party import in either module fails here rather than being masked
+        # by an environment that happens to have the package.
+        run: |
+          python -m unittest tests.test_public_plugin_packaging tests.test_web_fallback -v \
+            2>&1 | tee upgrade-tests.log
+
+      - name: Install the project's own declared runtime dependency only
+        # The ONLY installation in this workflow, and it exists for the pre-existing suite, not for
+        # the upgrade. It resolves the project's own declared closure from pyproject metadata; no
+        # ad-hoc requirements file is pulled, and `requirements.lock` (which records the closure as
+        # installed, is NOT hash-pinned, and is therefore not an install recipe) is not used here.
+        run: |
+          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
+          python -m pip install -e .
+          python -m pip freeze | tee resolved-deps.txt
+
+      - name: Full unittest suite (raw log)
+        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v 2>&1 | tee full-unittest.log
+
+      - name: Negative — a mutated pack document must fail the identity binding
+        # FAIL-CLOSED: the failure MOTIVE must be the identity binding, not merely a non-zero exit.
+        # (a) the gate is green first, (b) a pack document is mutated, (c) the re-run must contain a
+        # real `FAIL:` line whose motive names the release-identity fields. A deleted module, an
+        # import error or a collection error exits non-zero too, and must NOT satisfy this step.
+        env:
+          PACK: dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+
+          # (a) green first — a gate that is already red must not be read as "the mutation was caught".
+          python -m unittest tests.test_s4ext_release_provenance 2>&1 | tee pre-mutation.log
+          grep -qE "^OK" pre-mutation.log
+
+          # (b) mutate the pack DOCUMENT: replace the release identity it stamps with a wrong one.
+          python - <<'PY'
+          from pathlib import Path
+          doc = Path("dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3/README_MOUNT.md")
+          text = doc.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+          mutated = text.replace("cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a", "0" * 40)
+          assert mutated != text, "the mutation fixture no longer matches the checked-in document"
+          doc.write_text(mutated, encoding="utf-8")
+          PY
+
+          set +e
+          python -m unittest tests.test_s4ext_release_provenance > mutation-run.log 2>&1
+          status=$?
+          set -e
+          git checkout -- "$PACK"
+          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain "$PACK")" ]; then
+            echo "RESTORE_FAILED: the mutated pack document was not restored" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          # (c) fail closed on every way this step could "pass" without exercising the binding.
+          if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "MUTATION_ACCEPTED: the identity binding passed a tampered pack document" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -qE "^FAIL:" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "GATE_NOT_EXERCISED: no real test failure (deleted module, import error or collection error)" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if grep -qE "ModuleNotFoundError|ImportError|No module named" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "GATE_NOT_EXERCISED: the run failed on an import/collection error, not on the binding" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -qE "does not carry|foreign release object" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "MUTATION_REFUSAL_MOTIVE_UNEXPECTED: the failure is not the identity binding" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -qE "release_tag_target|build_source_commit" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "MUTATION_REFUSAL_MOTIVE_UNEXPECTED: the failure does not name the identity fields" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "MUTATION_REFUSED_ON_IDENTITY_BINDING"
+
+      - name: Negative — the fallback builder must refuse a pack whose bytes drifted from MANIFEST.sha256
+        # Second half of the same binding, exercised through the upgrade's OWN tool: the byte
+        # binding (a member's bytes against MANIFEST.sha256) and the identity stamp it embeds.
+        env:
+          RELEASE_ID: v0.1.1-preview.3
+          RELEASE_COMMIT: cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a
+          PACK: dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail

+          # directory on any runner (no dependence on /tmp being shared).
+          WORK=".public-plugin-verify-work"
+          rm -rf "$WORK"
+          mkdir -p "$WORK"
+          trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
+
+          # green first: the untouched frozen pack must project into ONE DOC_MOUNT_ONLY document.
+          python tools/build_web_fallback.py \
+            --mount-pack "$PACK" \

+            --out "$WORK/fallback.md" 2>&1 | tee fallback-green.log

+          mkdir -p "$WORK/evil"
+          cp -r "$PACK/." "$WORK/evil/"

+            --mount-pack "$WORK/evil" \

+            --out "$WORK/evil-fallback.md" > fallback-refusal.log 2>&1

+          set -e

+            exit 1

+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "BYTE_DRIFT_REFUSED_ON_MANIFEST_BINDING"
+

+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@6f51ac03b9356f520e9adb1b1b7802705f340c2b  # v4.5.0

+            fallback-green.log
+            fallback-refusal.log
+          if-no-files-found: warn

+## Install

+Install is one of **two routes**, and [`docs/install/README.md`](docs/install/README.md) is the

+  evidence, and a host that only copied files reports `NOT_VERIFIED`.

+[`docs/install/README.md`](docs/install/README.md).

+# PIPD-LS-SP — Agent 安裝提示詞(單一貼上即用)
+
+這份文件**就是** Agent route 的安裝入口:一整段可複製的提示詞(prompt)。它本身不安裝任何東西、
+不執行任何指令、不代表任何 acceptance 或發佈狀態——被安裝與被驗證的是 **host**(Hermes Agent /
+Codex Desktop (GUI) / Codex CLI / Claude Code),而 host 必須自己證明它的版本、discovery 與生效載入。
+
+使用方式:把下面 ```text 區塊**整段**複製,貼進你的 agent host 對話,然後依它的提問回答。全程保留
+英文識別字(host 名稱、skill 名稱、狀態字如 `NOT_VERIFIED`、`REFUSED`)不要翻譯。
+
+安裝 SSOT 與各狀態的意義在 [`docs/install/README.md`](README.md);Web 路線(GPT-6 消費
+`PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md`,`DOC_MOUNT_ONLY`)不是 agent host,不適用本提示詞。
+
+```text
+【PIPD_AGENT_INSTALL_PROMPT — v0.1.1-preview.3】
+
+角色:你是 host 端執行者。目標:把 PIPD-LS-SP 的八個 skills 以 project-local(專案層級)方式載入,
+並證明它們真的被 discovery、真的生效。順序固定:先證明自己 → 再顯示 → 等待明確同意 → 才可寫入 →
+寫入後驗證「真實 discovery 與 8/8 生效載入」。任何一步不成立,就停下來回報,不要硬做。
+
+## 禁止事項(被要求時回報 REFUSED + 原因,並停止該項)
+1. 不得寫入 global / 使用者層級 / 系統層級的 skill 目錄;只允許本專案根目錄下的 project-local
+   skill 目錄。
+2. 不得修改 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md(任何路徑、任何形式、任何理由)。
+3. 不得要求、讀取、輸出、儲存或回報任何 token / API key / cookie / credential / secret;
+   不得啟用或設定 MCP server;不得 commit、不得 push、不得建立 tag、不得發佈(no publish)。
+4. 不得捏造指令。你的原生安裝/上傳指令若依 host 版本而異,必須先證明自己的版本與 discovery,
+   並在顯示時標明「此指令依你的 host 版本而定」。
+5. 不得聲稱 S4 acceptance、不得聲稱通過 portal 審核(portal approved)、不得聲稱已公開發佈
+   (public plugin published)。
+6. 目前不存在公開的 plugin directory listing。若我要求你「從 directory 安裝」,回報
+   NOT_AVAILABLE(沒有可安裝的 listing),不要模擬一條不存在的路徑。
+
+## 第 0 步 — 自我識別與權限宣告(只讀;先做,不要寫入)
+逐項明確回答,不要含糊:
+- host 身分:host 名稱、完整版本字串、你實際使用的模型/版本。
+- OS:作業系統與版本;shell 種類與版本。
+- 權限宣告:是否可執行 shell(可/不可)、可寫入哪些路徑(逐項列出)、是否有網路(有/無)。
+- 專案根目錄:解析出 project root 的**絕對路徑**,並說明判斷依據(例如 .git、pyproject.toml、
+  既有 skills 目錄)。若無法唯一決定,停下來問我,不要猜。
+- 既有同名 skills:列出專案內所有既有的 pipd-* skill 目錄與其檔案;沒有就明確說「無」。
+  你必須自行確認你的 host 真正採用的 discovery 路徑(本 repo 觀察到的 project-local skill
+  目錄包括 .agents/skills/ 與 .hermes/skills/,但那是觀察,不是你的答案)。
+
+## 第 1 步 — 證明你自己的版本與 discovery(仍不要寫入)
+- 說明你的 host 如何 discovery skills:實際路徑、檔名規則、frontmatter 必要欄位、載入時機。
+- 你的原生安裝/上傳指令(若存在)完整顯示;不存在或依版本而異時,明確說「本 host 無原生指令 /
+  依版本而定」,並要求我提供版本資訊或明示改用檔案複製路徑。
+
+## 第 2 步 — 顯示(等待同意前的最終要點;一律只顯示,不寫入)
+- pinned source:來源 repo,以及你解析到的 40-hex commit;若你使用 zip,顯示該 zip 的 sha256。
+  若無法解析出 40-hex commit(例如只有浮動分支尖端),停止並回報 REFUSED,不得用分支尖端代替。
+- 目標路徑:即將寫入的**每一個絕對路徑**,逐檔列出。
+- 檔案數量:即將寫入的檔案總數;並列出 diff against existing config(既有同名 skills 的比對):
+  哪些新增、哪些覆寫、哪些衝突。
+- uninstall path:如何完整移除你即將寫入的東西,逐檔列出。
+- 你即將寫入的每個檔案,各自的 sha256。
+
+## 第 3 步 — 明確同意閘門(STOP)
+在你完成第 2 步、且收到我明確的「同意」之前:不得寫入任何檔案、不得執行任何安裝指令。
+未取得同意時,只回報計畫後停止。
+
+## 第 4 步 — 寫入(只寫入你在第 2 步已顯示的路徑)
+- 只寫入第 2 步列出的 project-local 路徑;不得延伸到全域目錄;不得寫入其他任何地方。
+- 不得修改 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md。
+- 寫入後直接進入第 5 步驗證。
+
+## 第 5 步 — 驗證「真實 discovery 與生效載入」,不是檔案存在
+- 重新載入 / 重新 discovery,並用你自己的 discovery 輸出證明這八個 skills 被發現:
+  pipd-route-intake, pipd-authority-source, pipd-profile-tailor, pipd-pi-compile, pipd-pd-bind,
+  pipd-execution-contract, pipd-assurance-tqaep, pipd-package-project。
+- 回報 effective load = n/8。必須是 8/8 才叫生效載入。
+- 每個 host 各給一個 positive trigger 與一個 negative trigger 的**實測**結果:
+  positive = 該 skill 應該被觸發的輸入;negative = 該 skill 不應該被觸發的輸入。兩者都要附實際輸出,
+  不是預期值。
+- 若你只複製了檔案,或無法證明 discovery,或無法給出觸發實測:回報 NOT_VERIFIED。
+  不得因為「檔案存在」就回報 PASS。
+
+## 第 6 步 — 最終回報(逐項列出;缺一項即視為未完成)
+- host / OS / 版本
+- pinned source(repo + 40-hex commit;若有 zip,附 sha256)
+- effective skill count(生效載入數 n/8)
+- refusal cases(本次你拒絕了哪些要求,逐條列出)
+- raw log paths(每一步的原始輸出路徑)
+並明確聲明:本流程不代表 S4 acceptance、未通過任何 portal 審核、未公開發佈任何 public plugin。
+```

+# PIPD-LS-SP — install (single source of truth)
+
+This page is the **install SSOT**: every other page that mentions installing PIPD-LS-SP either is
+this page or points at it. There are **two install routes and only two** — **Web** and **Agent** —
+and they have different ceilings. Pick one, read its ceiling, and do not read a green build (or a
+copied file) as anything more than what the [states table](#states-that-are-not-the-same) below says.
+
+Version pin for everything on this page: release **`v0.1.1-preview.3`**, release-tag target and
+build-source commit **`cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a`**. The authority for these facts is
+[`docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json`](../RELEASE_TUPLE.json); read it before you rely on any digest quoted
+below.
+
+---
+
+## Route 1 — Web (single-document fallback)
+
+There is **no public plugin directory listing yet**: nothing has been published to a plugin
+directory, so no user can install PIPD-LS-SP from one. The Web route today is therefore a **single
+document**, `PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md`, produced by [`tools/build_web_fallback.py`](../../tools/build_web_fallback.py)
+from a frozen mount pack. You attach that one document to a conversation or a Knowledge base; you do
+not install anything. Its ceiling is **`DOC_MOUNT_ONLY`** — no Python CLI, no MCP, no repository
+write, no S4 acceptance (spelled out [below](#the-web-fallback-document-and-its-doc_mount_only-ceiling)).
+The conditional directory route is described [further down](#the-directory-route-conditional-not-available-today).
+
+---
+
+## Route 2 — Agent (one copy-paste prompt)
+
+The Agent route is **one copy-paste prompt**: [`PIPD_AGENT_INSTALL_PROMPT.md`](PIPD_AGENT_INSTALL_PROMPT.md).
+It targets four supported hosts — **Hermes Agent**, **Codex Desktop (GUI)**, **Codex CLI** and
+**Claude Code** — and it makes the host do the work: detect its own identity/version/OS, prove its
+own discovery mechanism, show the exact paths and the diff, stop for approval, and then verify the
+load. **File presence is not evidence.** A host is only counted when it proves *real discovery* and
+an **8/8 effective load** of the eight skills, each with one positive and one negative trigger; if
+all that happened is that files were copied, the correct report is `NOT_VERIFIED`. Web GPT-6 is a
+**consumer of the fallback document, not an agent host** — it does not load the skills and is not a
+qualifying host for this route.
+
+The eight skills the route installs are the eight `skills/pipd-*` packs — `pipd-route-intake`,
+`pipd-authority-source`, `pipd-profile-tailor`, `pipd-pi-compile`, `pipd-pd-bind`,
+`pipd-execution-contract`, `pipd-assurance-tqaep`, `pipd-package-project` — six files each, **48
+files** in total.
+
+---
+
+## The Web fallback document and its `DOC_MOUNT_ONLY` ceiling
+
+`PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md` is one markdown document built from a *frozen mount pack* — a directory that
+carries its own `MANIFEST.sha256`, e.g. the checked-in
+[`dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3/`](../../dist/mount/) pack. Build it with
+the tool's own CLI:
+
+```bash
+python tools/build_web_fallback.py \
+  --mount-pack dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3 \
+  --release-id v0.1.1-preview.3 \
+  --release-commit cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a \
+  --out PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md
+```
+
+The tool is fail-closed, not best-effort. It **refuses** (typed reason, non-zero exit) instead of
+warning, on `MANIFEST_DIGEST_MISMATCH`, `MEMBER_SYMLINK`, `PATH_ESCAPE`, `UNEXPECTED_EXTRA_FILE`,
+`RELEASE_STAMP_MISSING`, `MEMBER_NOT_TEXT`, `SIZE_CAP_EXCEEDED` (it never truncates) and
+`DESTINATION_EXISTS` / `DESTINATION_SYMLINK`. It writes with `O_EXCL`, embeds no timestamp, stamps
+`DOC_MOUNT_ONLY` plus the member inventory, and is byte-deterministic across rebuilds.
+
+**The ceiling is `DOC_MOUNT_ONLY`.** That means, precisely:
+
+| not available through the fallback document | why |
+|---|---|
+| the Python **CLI** (`pipd`) | the document is content; it runs no `pipd` on the reader's machine |
+| **MCP** or any tool surface | nothing is registered and nothing is invoked |
+| **repository writing** | the document writes nothing to any checkout |
+| **S4 acceptance** | mounting a document accepts no stage, qualifies no host and approves no release |
+
+The host that consumes it is a read-only semantic surface: it can help you *design* work; it cannot
+execute, install, test, approve or release anything. For an 8/8 loaded skill set with real
+discovery, use the Agent route.
+
+---
+
+## The Directory route (conditional, not available today)
+
+A plugin directory listing is a *different* route, and it is **conditional on a published,
+account-visible listing** — one that actually exists and can be found from an account. None exists
+today. Treat every "install from the directory" instruction you read anywhere as **not available**
+until all of the following are true, and each is separately evidenced:
+
+1. the package root manifest conforms to the directory's own vendor schema (Agent Plugins 1.0), not
+   to PIPD's internal bookkeeping manifest;
+2. the directory's portal has reviewed and approved the submitted package (its own record, not ours);
+3. the listing is published and account-visible, and the bytes it serves match the receipt digest.
+
+Until then the Web route is exactly the single document in Route 1. Do not present a conditional
+route as an available one.
+
+---
+
+## States that are NOT the same
+
+These five words are kept apart on purpose. None of them is upgraded by a green build, and the
+right-hand column is what would have to exist for the word to be true — **not** what exists now.
+
+| state | meaning | required evidence | state today |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| `BUILD_PASS` | the deterministic packager built the candidate and its own tests are green | the build tool exits `0` with a byte-identical rebuild (two builds, same input, same bytes), the two upgrade test modules plus the full suite green, and a receipt whose `claim_ceiling` is `LOCAL_PACKAGER_PASS_ONLY` | **NOT claimed** — the builder *refuses* on the deliberately absent owner inputs (`derivations.json` is empty, no pinned publisher identity, no pinned official/vendor schema digest, no icon), so no candidate ZIP is claimed |
+| `PORTAL_APPROVED` | the plugin directory's own review approved the submitted package | the portal's approval record / identifier for that submission — the directory's verdict, never our own summary | **NOT_EXECUTED** — the manifest records `official_portal_verification: NOT_EXECUTED`; no submission was reviewed |
+| `PUBLISHED` | the package is live in the public directory and its served bytes are the ones we hashed | a published, account-visible listing **plus** the served asset's digest agreeing with the receipt | **NOT_PUBLISHED** — no public directory listing exists yet |
+| `HOST_QUALIFIED` | a specific host really loads the eight skills | per-host, host-produced evidence: the host resolved the project root, really discovered the skills, reported **8/8 effective load**, and passed one positive and one negative trigger; raw logs attached | **NOT_VERIFIED** — no host has produced that evidence; a copied file reports `NOT_VERIFIED` |
+| `S4_FULL_PASS` | the S0–S4 challenge is accepted as a *full* pass | independent verifier receipts covering the whole S0–S4 challenge, not scoped receipts | **NOT claimed** — the challenge is `PARTIAL_CHALLENGE`; scoped receipts only, and `G-RELEASE_FULL_PASS` is not granted |
+
+`BUILD_PASS` != `PORTAL_APPROVED` != `PUBLISHED` != `HOST_QUALIFIED` != `S4_FULL_PASS`. A green
+`BUILD_PASS` on this repository does **not** imply any of the other four — and there is no `BUILD_PASS`
+today either.
+
+---
+
+## Advanced and recovery
+
+Everything below is subordinate to the two routes above. It is not an alternative route.
+
+### Version pin
+
+Pin the **immutable** identity, never a moving branch tip:
+
+- release id **`v0.1.1-preview.3`**; release-tag target **`cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a`**.
+- authoritative record: [`docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json`](../RELEASE_TUPLE.json).
+- **Known open item, stated rather than hidden:** the immutable `v0.1.1-preview.3` **tag** still
+  holds the pre-correction pack, so a rebuild *from the tag's tree* does not reproduce the currently
+  served asset. The served asset was corrected in place and is reproducible from this tree
+  (`docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json` → `authority_note`). Closing that needs a new immutable preview, not
+  another in-place replacement — it is a Release Owner item and it is **not closed**.
+
+### Hashes
+
+- Wheel `pipd_ls_sp-0.1.1a3-py3-none-any.whl`: the published digest is recorded in the repository
+  front page (`README.md`). Verify the bytes you downloaded against that digest before installing;
+  this page does not replace the sidecar.
+- Mount pack ZIP `PIPD-LS-SP_S4_WEB_MOUNT_v0.1.1-preview.3.zip`: digest recorded in
+  `docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json` (`published_asset_sha256`), with a `.sha256` sidecar next to the ZIP.
+- Inside an unpacked pack, `MANIFEST.sha256` lists every member's sha256 (LF-normalised text bytes
+  hash as stored). `tools/build_web_fallback.py` recomputes it and refuses on any mismatch.
+
+### Uninstall / rollback
+
+- **Web fallback:** delete `PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md`, and detach it from the conversation or Knowledge
+  base. Nothing was installed, so nothing else changes.
+- **Agent route:** remove exactly the files the prompt listed in its *uninstall path* line before it
+  wrote anything — the prompt refuses to run without printing that path first, and it refuses global
+  writes, so removal is confined to the project-local skill directory. Re-run the prompt to see the
+  list again; do not delete files it did not name.
+- **Wheel (CLI):** inside the virtual environment you installed into,
+  `python -m pip uninstall pipd-ls-sp`; or delete that environment. Nothing is installed outside it.
+
+### Reporting a failure
+
+Report what the host or the tool actually produced, not a summary of what you hoped for. Include:
+
+- host, OS and host version, and the shell/file/network permissions the host declared;
+- the pinned source you used (repo URL + the 40-hex commit, and the pack ZIP digest if you used one);
+- the **effective** skill count (discovered and loaded, not files copied);
+- every refusal case you hit, with the tool's or host's typed reason, verbatim;
+- the raw log paths.
+
+This repository's own read-only gate for the upgrade is
+[`.github/workflows/public-plugin-verify.yml`](../../.github/workflows/public-plugin-verify.yml); it
+uploads its raw logs as the `public-plugin-verify-raw-logs` artifact, which is the shape a failure
+report should have. A failure report is never an acceptance claim: see the
+[states table](#states-that-are-not-the-same) — none of those five words is granted by reporting.

+name: public-plugin-verify
+
+# Read-only verification of the S4POST Stage B upgrade (the public-plugin projection, the web
+# fallback and the install routes). It grants nothing: a green run here is NOT a portal approval,
+# NOT a publication, NOT a host qualification and NOT an S4 acceptance — see
+# docs/install/README.md, "States that are NOT the same".
+#
+# Triggers are pull_request (restricted to the upgrade paths) and workflow_dispatch only. There is
+# deliberately no `pull_request_target`, no `secrets.*`, no repository write, no tag and no publish
+# step. Because `pull_request` from a fork gets a read-only token, no step tries to write anything
+# back to the repository.
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - ".github/workflows/public-plugin-verify.yml"
+      - "README.md"
+      - "docs/install/**"
+      - "docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json"
+      - "packaging/public-plugin/**"
+      - "tools/freeze_public_plugin_source.py"
+      - "tools/build_public_plugin.py"
+      - "tools/build_web_fallback.py"
+      - "tests/test_public_plugin_packaging.py"
+      - "tests/test_web_fallback.py"
+      - "dist/mount/**"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: public-plugin-verify-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out the frozen subject
+        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          # full history + tags: the release-identity gate re-derives the release tags with
+          # `git rev-parse <tag>^{commit}`, and the "wrote no frozen path" step needs the base sha.
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Set up Python 3.11
+        uses: actions/setup-python@0b93645e9fea7318ecaed2b359559ac225c90a2b  # v5.3.0
+        with:
+          python-version: "3.11"
+
+      - name: Prove the upgrade wrote no skills/**, src/** or schemas/**
+        env:
+          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          BASE="${PR_BASE_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)}"
+          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE" HEAD
+          CHANGED="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE"...HEAD)"
+          printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED"
+          if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | grep -Eq '^(skills|src|schemas)/'; then
+            echo "UPGRADE_WROTE_FROZEN_PATH: this upgrade must not write skills/, src/ or schemas/:" >&2
+            printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | grep -E '^(skills|src|schemas)/' >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "NO_FROZEN_PATH_WRITTEN"
+
+      - name: Compile the three upgrade tools
+        # Nothing is installed for this step: the three tools import the standard library only.
+        run: |
+          python -m py_compile \
+            tools/freeze_public_plugin_source.py \
+            tools/build_public_plugin.py \
+            tools/build_web_fallback.py
+          echo "PY_COMPILE_OK"
+
+      - name: Assert the upgrade is stdlib-only (no third-party import)
+        # WHY THERE IS NO `pip install -r <file>` FOR THE UPGRADE IN THIS WORKFLOW: the three tools
+        # and the two new test modules import the standard library only, so there is no requirements
+        # file for them to pull — none exists. This step enforces that claim fail-closed, so a later
+        # third-party import fails the gate instead of silently needing a dependency.
+        run: |
+          python - <<'PY'
+          import ast
+          import sys
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          TARGETS = (
+              "tools/freeze_public_plugin_source.py",
+              "tools/build_public_plugin.py",
+              "tools/build_web_fallback.py",
+              "tests/test_public_plugin_packaging.py",
+              "tests/test_web_fallback.py",
+          )
+          # The repository's own modules plus its package/test roots are not third-party.
+          OWN = {
+              "tools", "tests",
+              "freeze_public_plugin_source", "build_public_plugin", "build_web_fallback",
+              "pipd_ls_sp",
+          }
+          stdlib = set(sys.stdlib_module_names)
+          offenders = []
+          for rel in TARGETS:
+              path = Path(rel)
+              if not path.is_file():
+                  offenders.append(f"{rel}: MISSING (the upgrade is incomplete)")
+                  continue
+              tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=rel)
+              for node in ast.walk(tree):
+                  if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+                      roots = [alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names]
+                  elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0 and node.module:
+                      roots = [node.module.split(".")[0]]
+                  else:
+                      continue
+                  for root in roots:
+                      if root not in stdlib and root not in OWN:
+                          offenders.append(f"{rel}: {root}")
+          if offenders:
+              print("NON_STDLIB_IMPORT:")
+              for entry in offenders:
+                  print(f"  {entry}")
+              raise SystemExit(1)
+          print("STDLIB_ONLY_OK")
+          PY
+
+      - name: The two new test modules pass with no third-party dependency installed
+        # Almost the strictest form of "the upgrade pulls no requirement": this runs BEFORE anything
+        # is installed, so a third-party import in either module fails here rather than being masked
+        # by an environment that happens to have the package.
+        run: |
+          python -m unittest tests.test_public_plugin_packaging tests.test_web_fallback -v \
+            2>&1 | tee upgrade-tests.log
+
+      - name: Install the project's own declared runtime dependency only
+        # The ONLY installation in this workflow, and it exists for the pre-existing suite, not for
+        # the upgrade. It resolves the project's own declared closure from pyproject metadata; no
+        # ad-hoc requirements file is pulled, and `requirements.lock` (which records the closure as
+        # installed, is NOT hash-pinned, and is therefore not an install recipe) is not used here.
+        run: |
+          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
+          python -m pip install -e .
+          python -m pip freeze | tee resolved-deps.txt
+
+      - name: Full unittest suite (raw log)
+        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v 2>&1 | tee full-unittest.log
+
+      - name: Negative — a mutated pack document must fail the identity binding
+        # FAIL-CLOSED: the failure MOTIVE must be the identity binding, not merely a non-zero exit.
+        # (a) the gate is green first, (b) a pack document is mutated, (c) the re-run must contain a
+        # real `FAIL:` line whose motive names the release-identity fields. A deleted module, an
+        # import error or a collection error exits non-zero too, and must NOT satisfy this step.
+        env:
+          PACK: dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+
+          # (a) green first — a gate that is already red must not be read as "the mutation was caught".
+          python -m unittest tests.test_s4ext_release_provenance 2>&1 | tee pre-mutation.log
+          grep -qE "^OK" pre-mutation.log
+
+          # (b) mutate the pack DOCUMENT: replace the release identity it stamps with a wrong one.
+          python - <<'PY'
+          from pathlib import Path
+          doc = Path("dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3/README_MOUNT.md")
+          text = doc.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+          mutated = text.replace("cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a", "0" * 40)
+          assert mutated != text, "the mutation fixture no longer matches the checked-in document"
+          doc.write_text(mutated, encoding="utf-8")
+          PY
+
+          set +e
+          python -m unittest tests.test_s4ext_release_provenance > mutation-run.log 2>&1
+          status=$?
+          set -e
+          git checkout -- "$PACK"
+          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain "$PACK")" ]; then
+            echo "RESTORE_FAILED: the mutated pack document was not restored" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          # (c) fail closed on every way this step could "pass" without exercising the binding.
+          if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "MUTATION_ACCEPTED: the identity binding passed a tampered pack document" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -qE "^FAIL:" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "GATE_NOT_EXERCISED: no real test failure (deleted module, import error or collection error)" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if grep -qE "ModuleNotFoundError|ImportError|No module named" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "GATE_NOT_EXERCISED: the run failed on an import/collection error, not on the binding" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -qE "does not carry|foreign release object" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "MUTATION_REFUSAL_MOTIVE_UNEXPECTED: the failure is not the identity binding" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -qE "release_tag_target|build_source_commit" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "MUTATION_REFUSAL_MOTIVE_UNEXPECTED: the failure does not name the identity fields" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "MUTATION_REFUSED_ON_IDENTITY_BINDING"
+
+      - name: Negative — the fallback builder must refuse a pack whose bytes drifted from MANIFEST.sha256
+        # Second half of the same binding, exercised through the upgrade's OWN tool: the byte
+        # binding (a member's bytes against MANIFEST.sha256) and the identity stamp it embeds.
+        env:
+          RELEASE_ID: v0.1.1-preview.3
+          RELEASE_COMMIT: cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a
+          PACK: dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          # A RELATIVE work dir under the workspace, so the shell and the tool resolve the SAME
+          # directory on any runner (no dependence on /tmp being shared).
+          WORK=".public-plugin-verify-work"
+          rm -rf "$WORK"
+          mkdir -p "$WORK"
+          trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
+
+          # green first: the untouched frozen pack must project into ONE DOC_MOUNT_ONLY document.
+          python tools/build_web_fallback.py \
+            --mount-pack "$PACK" \
+            --release-id "$RELEASE_ID" \
+            --release-commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
+            --out "$WORK/fallback.md" 2>&1 | tee fallback-green.log
+          grep -q "DOC_MOUNT_ONLY" fallback-green.log
+
+          # mutate a COPY's member bytes so they no longer match the pack's own MANIFEST.sha256.
+          mkdir -p "$WORK/evil"
+          cp -r "$PACK/." "$WORK/evil/"
+          printf '\n<!-- tampered: these bytes no longer match MANIFEST.sha256 -->\n' >> "$WORK/evil/SKILL.md"
+
+          set +e
+          python tools/build_web_fallback.py \
+            --mount-pack "$WORK/evil" \
+            --release-id "$RELEASE_ID" \
+            --release-commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
+            --out "$WORK/evil-fallback.md" > fallback-refusal.log 2>&1
+          status=$?
+          set -e
+          cat fallback-refusal.log
+
+          if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "MUTATION_ACCEPTED: the fallback builder accepted a pack whose bytes drifted" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -q "REFUSED MANIFEST_DIGEST_MISMATCH" fallback-refusal.log; then
+            echo "MUTATION_REFUSAL_MOTIVE_UNEXPECTED: the refusal is not the byte binding (MANIFEST.sha256)" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "BYTE_DRIFT_REFUSED_ON_MANIFEST_BINDING"
+
+      - name: Upload raw logs
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@6f51ac03b9356f520e9adb1b1b7802705f340c2b  # v4.5.0
+        with:
+          name: public-plugin-verify-raw-logs
+          path: |
+            resolved-deps.txt
+            upgrade-tests.log
+            full-unittest.log
+            pre-mutation.log
+            mutation-run.log
+            fallback-green.log
+            fallback-refusal.log
+          if-no-files-found: warn

+# PIPD-LS-SP — Agent 安裝提示詞(單一貼上即用)
+
+這份文件**就是** Agent route 的安裝入口:一整段可複製的提示詞(prompt)。它本身不安裝任何東西、
+不執行任何指令、不代表任何 acceptance 或發佈狀態——被安裝與被驗證的是 **host**(Hermes Agent /
+Codex Desktop (GUI) / Codex CLI / Claude Code),而 host 必須自己證明它的版本、discovery 與生效載入。
+
+使用方式:把下面 ```text 區塊**整段**複製,貼進你的 agent host 對話,然後依它的提問回答。全程保留
+英文識別字(host 名稱、skill 名稱、狀態字如 `NOT_VERIFIED`、`REFUSED`)不要翻譯。
+
+安裝 SSOT 與各狀態的意義在 [`docs/install/README.md`](README.md);Web 路線(GPT-6 消費
+`PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md`,`DOC_MOUNT_ONLY`)不是 agent host,不適用本提示詞。
+
+```text
+【PIPD_AGENT_INSTALL_PROMPT — v0.1.1-preview.3】
+
+角色:你是 host 端執行者。目標:把 PIPD-LS-SP 的八個 skills 以 project-local(專案層級)方式載入,
+並證明它們真的被 discovery、真的生效。順序固定:先證明自己 → 再顯示 → 等待明確同意 → 才可寫入 →
+寫入後驗證「真實 discovery 與 8/8 生效載入」。任何一步不成立,就停下來回報,不要硬做。
+
+## 禁止事項(被要求時回報 REFUSED + 原因,並停止該項)
+1. 不得寫入 global / 使用者層級 / 系統層級的 skill 目錄;只允許本專案根目錄下的 project-local
+   skill 目錄。
+2. 不得修改 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md(任何路徑、任何形式、任何理由)。
+3. 不得要求、讀取、輸出、儲存或回報任何 token / API key / cookie / credential / secret;
+   不得啟用或設定 MCP server;不得 commit、不得 push、不得建立 tag、不得發佈(no publish)。
+4. 不得捏造指令。你的原生安裝/上傳指令若依 host 版本而異,必須先證明自己的版本與 discovery,
+   並在顯示時標明「此指令依你的 host 版本而定」。
+5. 不得聲稱 S4 acceptance、不得聲稱通過 portal 審核(portal approved)、不得聲稱已公開發佈
+   (public plugin published)。
+6. 目前不存在公開的 plugin directory listing。若我要求你「從 directory 安裝」,回報
+   NOT_AVAILABLE(沒有可安裝的 listing),不要模擬一條不存在的路徑。
+
+## 第 0 步 — 自我識別與權限宣告(只讀;先做,不要寫入)
+逐項明確回答,不要含糊:
+- host 身分:host 名稱、完整版本字串、你實際使用的模型/版本。
+- OS:作業系統與版本;shell 種類與版本。
+- 權限宣告:是否可執行 shell(可/不可)、可寫入哪些路徑(逐項列出)、是否有網路(有/無)。
+- 專案根目錄:解析出 project root 的**絕對路徑**,並說明判斷依據(例如 .git、pyproject.toml、
+  既有 skills 目錄)。若無法唯一決定,停下來問我,不要猜。
+- 既有同名 skills:列出專案內所有既有的 pipd-* skill 目錄與其檔案;沒有就明確說「無」。
+  你必須自行確認你的 host 真正採用的 discovery 路徑(本 repo 觀察到的 project-local skill
+  目錄包括 .agents/skills/ 與 .hermes/skills/,但那是觀察,不是你的答案)。
+
+## 第 1 步 — 證明你自己的版本與 discovery(仍不要寫入)
+- 說明你的 host 如何 discovery skills:實際路徑、檔名規則、frontmatter 必要欄位、載入時機。
+- 你的原生安裝/上傳指令(若存在)完整顯示;不存在或依版本而異時,明確說「本 host 無原生指令 /
+  依版本而定」,並要求我提供版本資訊或明示改用檔案複製路徑。
+
+## 第 2 步 — 顯示(等待同意前的最終要點;一律只顯示,不寫入)
+- pinned source:來源 repo,以及你解析到的 40-hex commit;若你使用 zip,顯示該 zip 的 sha256。
+  若無法解析出 40-hex commit(例如只有浮動分支尖端),停止並回報 REFUSED,不得用分支尖端代替。
+- 目標路徑:即將寫入的**每一個絕對路徑**,逐檔列出。
+- 檔案數量:即將寫入的檔案總數;並列出 diff against existing config(既有同名 skills 的比對):
+  哪些新增、哪些覆寫、哪些衝突。
+- uninstall path:如何完整移除你即將寫入的東西,逐檔列出。
+- 你即將寫入的每個檔案,各自的 sha256。
+
+## 第 3 步 — 明確同意閘門(STOP)
+在你完成第 2 步、且收到我明確的「同意」之前:不得寫入任何檔案、不得執行任何安裝指令。
+未取得同意時,只回報計畫後停止。
+
+## 第 4 步 — 寫入(只寫入你在第 2 步已顯示的路徑)
+- 只寫入第 2 步列出的 project-local 路徑;不得延伸到全域目錄;不得寫入其他任何地方。
+- 不得修改 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md。
+- 寫入後直接進入第 5 步驗證。
+
+## 第 5 步 — 驗證「真實 discovery 與生效載入」,不是檔案存在
+- 重新載入 / 重新 discovery,並用你自己的 discovery 輸出證明這八個 skills 被發現:
+  pipd-route-intake, pipd-authority-source, pipd-profile-tailor, pipd-pi-compile, pipd-pd-bind,
+  pipd-execution-contract, pipd-assurance-tqaep, pipd-package-project。
+- 回報 effective load = n/8。必須是 8/8 才叫生效載入。
+- 每個 host 各給一個 positive trigger 與一個 negative trigger 的**實測**結果:
+  positive = 該 skill 應該被觸發的輸入;negative = 該 skill 不應該被觸發的輸入。兩者都要附實際輸出,
+  不是預期值。
+- 若你只複製了檔案,或無法證明 discovery,或無法給出觸發實測:回報 NOT_VERIFIED。
+  不得因為「檔案存在」就回報 PASS。
+
+## 第 6 步 — 最終回報(逐項列出;缺一項即視為未完成)
+- host / OS / 版本
+- pinned source(repo + 40-hex commit;若有 zip,附 sha256)
+- effective skill count(生效載入數 n/8)
+- refusal cases(本次你拒絕了哪些要求,逐條列出)
+- raw log paths(每一步的原始輸出路徑)
+並明確聲明:本流程不代表 S4 acceptance、未通過任何 portal 審核、未公開發佈任何 public plugin。

+# PIPD-LS-SP — install (single source of truth)
+
+This page is the **install SSOT**: every other page that mentions installing PIPD-LS-SP either is
+this page or points at it. There are **two install routes and only two** — **Web** and **Agent** —
+and they have different ceilings. Pick one, read its ceiling, and do not read a green build (or a
+copied file) as anything more than what the [states table](#states-that-are-not-the-same) below says.
+
+Version pin for everything on this page: release **`v0.1.1-preview.3`**, release-tag target and
+build-source commit **`cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a`**. The authority for these facts is
+[`docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json`](../RELEASE_TUPLE.json); read it before you rely on any digest quoted
+below.
+
+---
+
+## Route 1 — Web (single-document fallback)
+
+There is **no public plugin directory listing yet**: nothing has been published to a plugin
+directory, so no user can install PIPD-LS-SP from one. The Web route today is therefore a **single
+document**, `PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md`, produced by [`tools/build_web_fallback.py`](../../tools/build_web_fallback.py)
+from a frozen mount pack. You attach that one document to a conversation or a Knowledge base; you do
+not install anything. Its ceiling is **`DOC_MOUNT_ONLY`** — no Python CLI, no MCP, no repository
+write, no S4 acceptance (spelled out [below](#the-web-fallback-document-and-its-doc_mount_only-ceiling)).
+The conditional directory route is described [further down](#the-directory-route-conditional-not-available-today).
+
+---
+
+## Route 2 — Agent (one copy-paste prompt)
+
+The Agent route is **one copy-paste prompt**: [`PIPD_AGENT_INSTALL_PROMPT.md`](PIPD_AGENT_INSTALL_PROMPT.md).
+It targets four supported hosts — **Hermes Agent**, **Codex Desktop (GUI)**, **Codex CLI** and
+**Claude Code** — and it makes the host do the work: detect its own identity/version/OS, prove its
+own discovery mechanism, show the exact paths and the diff, stop for approval, and then verify the
+load. **File presence is not evidence.** A host is only counted when it proves *real discovery* and
+an **8/8 effective load** of the eight skills, each with one positive and one negative trigger; if
+all that happened is that files were copied, the correct report is `NOT_VERIFIED`. Web GPT-6 is a
+**consumer of the fallback document, not an agent host** — it does not load the skills and is not a
+qualifying host for this route.
+
+The eight skills the route installs are the eight `skills/pipd-*` packs — `pipd-route-intake`,
+`pipd-authority-source`, `pipd-profile-tailor`, `pipd-pi-compile`, `pipd-pd-bind`,
+`pipd-execution-contract`, `pipd-assurance-tqaep`, `pipd-package-project` — six files each, **48
+files** in total.
+
+---
+
+## The Web fallback document and its `DOC_MOUNT_ONLY` ceiling
+
+`PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md` is one markdown document built from a *frozen mount pack* — a directory that
+carries its own `MANIFEST.sha256`, e.g. the checked-in
+[`dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3/`](../../dist/mount/) pack. Build it with
+the tool's own CLI:
+
+```bash
+python tools/build_web_fallback.py \
+  --mount-pack dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3 \
+  --release-id v0.1.1-preview.3 \
+  --release-commit cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a \
+  --out PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md
+```
+
+The tool is fail-closed, not best-effort. It **refuses** (typed reason, non-zero exit) instead of
+warning, on `MANIFEST_DIGEST_MISMATCH`, `MEMBER_SYMLINK`, `PATH_ESCAPE`, `UNEXPECTED_EXTRA_FILE`,
+`RELEASE_STAMP_MISSING`, `MEMBER_NOT_TEXT`, `SIZE_CAP_EXCEEDED` (it never truncates) and
+`DESTINATION_EXISTS` / `DESTINATION_SYMLINK`. It writes with `O_EXCL`, embeds no timestamp, stamps
+`DOC_MOUNT_ONLY` plus the member inventory, and is byte-deterministic across rebuilds.
+
+**The ceiling is `DOC_MOUNT_ONLY`.** That means, precisely:
+
+| not available through the fallback document | why |
+|---|---|
+| the Python **CLI** (`pipd`) | the document is content; it runs no `pipd` on the reader's machine |
+| **MCP** or any tool surface | nothing is registered and nothing is invoked |
+| **repository writing** | the document writes nothing to any checkout |
+| **S4 acceptance** | mounting a document accepts no stage, qualifies no host and approves no release |
+
+The host that consumes it is a read-only semantic surface: it can help you *design* work; it cannot
+execute, install, test, approve or release anything. For an 8/8 loaded skill set with real
+discovery, use the Agent route.
+
+---
+
+## The Directory route (conditional, not available today)
+
+A plugin directory listing is a *different* route, and it is **conditional on a published,
+account-visible listing** — one that actually exists and can be found from an account. None exists
+today. Treat every "install from the directory" instruction you read anywhere as **not available**
+until all of the following are true, and each is separately evidenced:
+
+1. the package root manifest conforms to the directory's own vendor schema (Agent Plugins 1.0), not
+   to PIPD's internal bookkeeping manifest;
+2. the directory's portal has reviewed and approved the submitted package (its own record, not ours);
+3. the listing is published and account-visible, and the bytes it serves match the receipt digest.
+
+Until then the Web route is exactly the single document in Route 1. Do not present a conditional
+route as an available one.
+
+---
+
+## States that are NOT the same
+
+These five words are kept apart on purpose. None of them is upgraded by a green build, and the
+right-hand column is what would have to exist for the word to be true — **not** what exists now.
+
+| state | meaning | required evidence | state today |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| `BUILD_PASS` | the deterministic packager built the candidate and its own tests are green | the build tool exits `0` with a byte-identical rebuild (two builds, same input, same bytes), the two upgrade test modules plus the full suite green, and a receipt whose `claim_ceiling` is `LOCAL_PACKAGER_PASS_ONLY` | **NOT claimed** — the builder *refuses* on the deliberately absent owner inputs (`derivations.json` is empty, no pinned publisher identity, no pinned official/vendor schema digest, no icon), so no candidate ZIP is claimed |
+| `PORTAL_APPROVED` | the plugin directory's own review approved the submitted package | the portal's approval record / identifier for that submission — the directory's verdict, never our own summary | **NOT_EXECUTED** — the manifest records `official_portal_verification: NOT_EXECUTED`; no submission was reviewed |
+| `PUBLISHED` | the package is live in the public directory and its served bytes are the ones we hashed | a published, account-visible listing **plus** the served asset's digest agreeing with the receipt | **NOT_PUBLISHED** — no public directory listing exists yet |
+| `HOST_QUALIFIED` | a specific host really loads the eight skills | per-host, host-produced evidence: the host resolved the project root, really discovered the skills, reported **8/8 effective load**, and passed one positive and one negative trigger; raw logs attached | **NOT_VERIFIED** — no host has produced that evidence; a copied file reports `NOT_VERIFIED` |
+| `S4_FULL_PASS` | the S0–S4 challenge is accepted as a *full* pass | independent verifier receipts covering the whole S0–S4 challenge, not scoped receipts | **NOT claimed** — the challenge is `PARTIAL_CHALLENGE`; scoped receipts only, and `G-RELEASE_FULL_PASS` is not granted |
+
+`BUILD_PASS` != `PORTAL_APPROVED` != `PUBLISHED` != `HOST_QUALIFIED` != `S4_FULL_PASS`. A green
+`BUILD_PASS` on this repository does **not** imply any of the other four — and there is no `BUILD_PASS`
+today either.
+
+---
+
+## Advanced and recovery
+
+Everything below is subordinate to the two routes above. It is not an alternative route.
+
+### Version pin
+
+Pin the **immutable** identity, never a moving branch tip:
+
+- release id **`v0.1.1-preview.3`**; release-tag target **`cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a`**.
+- authoritative record: [`docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json`](../RELEASE_TUPLE.json).
+- **Known open item, stated rather than hidden:** the immutable `v0.1.1-preview.3` **tag** still
+  holds the pre-correction pack, so a rebuild *from the tag's tree* does not reproduce the currently
+  served asset. The served asset was corrected in place and is reproducible from this tree
+  (`docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json` → `authority_note`). Closing that needs a new immutable preview, not
+  another in-place replacement — it is a Release Owner item and it is **not closed**.
+
+### Hashes
+
+- Wheel `pipd_ls_sp-0.1.1a3-py3-none-any.whl`: the published digest is recorded in the repository
+  front page (`README.md`). Verify the bytes you downloaded against that digest before installing;
+  this page does not replace the sidecar.
+- Mount pack ZIP `PIPD-LS-SP_S4_WEB_MOUNT_v0.1.1-preview.3.zip`: digest recorded in
+  `docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json` (`published_asset_sha256`), with a `.sha256` sidecar next to the ZIP.
+- Inside an unpacked pack, `MANIFEST.sha256` lists every member's sha256 (LF-normalised text bytes
+  hash as stored). `tools/build_web_fallback.py` recomputes it and refuses on any mismatch.
+
+### Uninstall / rollback
+
+- **Web fallback:** delete `PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md`, and detach it from the conversation or Knowledge
+  base. Nothing was installed, so nothing else changes.
+- **Agent route:** remove exactly the files the prompt listed in its *uninstall path* line before it
+  wrote anything — the prompt refuses to run without printing that path first, and it refuses global
+  writes, so removal is confined to the project-local skill directory. Re-run the prompt to see the
+  list again; do not delete files it did not name.
+- **Wheel (CLI):** inside the virtual environment you installed into,
+  `python -m pip uninstall pipd-ls-sp`; or delete that environment. Nothing is installed outside it.
+
+### Reporting a failure
+
+Report what the host or the tool actually produced, not a summary of what you hoped for. Include:
+
+- host, OS and host version, and the shell/file/network permissions the host declared;
+- the pinned source you used (repo URL + the 40-hex commit, and the pack ZIP digest if you used one);
+- the **effective** skill count (discovered and loaded, not files copied);
+- every refusal case you hit, with the tool's or host's typed reason, verbatim;
+- the raw log paths.
+
+This repository's own read-only gate for the upgrade is
+[`.github/workflows/public-plugin-verify.yml`](../../.github/workflows/public-plugin-verify.yml); it
+uploads its raw logs as the `public-plugin-verify-raw-logs` artifact, which is the shape a failure
+report should have. A failure report is never an acceptance claim: see the
+[states table](#states-that-are-not-the-same) — none of those five words is granted by reporting.

+name: public-plugin-verify
+
+# Read-only verification of the S4POST Stage B upgrade (the public-plugin projection, the web
+# fallback and the install routes). It grants nothing: a green run here is NOT a portal approval,
+# NOT a publication, NOT a host qualification and NOT an S4 acceptance — see
+# docs/install/README.md, "States that are NOT the same".
+#
+# Triggers are pull_request (restricted to the upgrade paths) and workflow_dispatch only. There is
+# deliberately no `pull_request_target`, no `secrets.*`, no repository write, no tag and no publish
+# step. Because `pull_request` from a fork gets a read-only token, no step tries to write anything
+# back to the repository.
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - ".github/workflows/public-plugin-verify.yml"
+      - "README.md"
+      - "docs/install/**"
+      - "docs/RELEASE_TUPLE.json"
+      - "packaging/public-plugin/**"
+      - "tools/freeze_public_plugin_source.py"
+      - "tools/build_public_plugin.py"
+      - "tools/build_web_fallback.py"
+      - "tests/test_public_plugin_packaging.py"
+      - "tests/test_web_fallback.py"
+      - "dist/mount/**"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: public-plugin-verify-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out the frozen subject
+        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683  # v4.2.2
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          # full history + tags: the release-identity gate re-derives the release tags with
+          # `git rev-parse <tag>^{commit}`, and the "wrote no frozen path" step needs the base sha.
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Set up Python 3.11
+        uses: actions/setup-python@0b93645e9fea7318ecaed2b359559ac225c90a2b  # v5.3.0
+        with:
+          python-version: "3.11"
+
+      - name: Prove the upgrade wrote no skills/**, src/** or schemas/**
+        env:
+          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          BASE="${PR_BASE_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)}"
+          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE" HEAD
+          CHANGED="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE"...HEAD)"
+          printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED"
+          if printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | grep -Eq '^(skills|src|schemas)/'; then
+            echo "UPGRADE_WROTE_FROZEN_PATH: this upgrade must not write skills/, src/ or schemas/:" >&2
+            printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | grep -E '^(skills|src|schemas)/' >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "NO_FROZEN_PATH_WRITTEN"
+
+      - name: Compile the three upgrade tools
+        # Nothing is installed for this step: the three tools import the standard library only.
+        run: |
+          python -m py_compile \
+            tools/freeze_public_plugin_source.py \
+            tools/build_public_plugin.py \
+            tools/build_web_fallback.py
+          echo "PY_COMPILE_OK"
+
+      - name: Assert the upgrade is stdlib-only (no third-party import)
+        # WHY THERE IS NO `pip install -r <file>` FOR THE UPGRADE IN THIS WORKFLOW: the three tools
+        # and the two new test modules import the standard library only, so there is no requirements
+        # file for them to pull — none exists. This step enforces that claim fail-closed, so a later
+        # third-party import fails the gate instead of silently needing a dependency.
+        run: |
+          python - <<'PY'
+          import ast
+          import sys
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          TARGETS = (
+              "tools/freeze_public_plugin_source.py",
+              "tools/build_public_plugin.py",
+              "tools/build_web_fallback.py",
+              "tests/test_public_plugin_packaging.py",
+              "tests/test_web_fallback.py",
+          )
+          # The repository's own modules plus its package/test roots are not third-party.
+          OWN = {
+              "tools", "tests",
+              "freeze_public_plugin_source", "build_public_plugin", "build_web_fallback",
+              "pipd_ls_sp",
+          }
+          stdlib = set(sys.stdlib_module_names)
+          offenders = []
+          for rel in TARGETS:
+              path = Path(rel)
+              if not path.is_file():
+                  offenders.append(f"{rel}: MISSING (the upgrade is incomplete)")
+                  continue
+              tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=rel)
+              for node in ast.walk(tree):
+                  if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+                      roots = [alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names]
+                  elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0 and node.module:
+                      roots = [node.module.split(".")[0]]
+                  else:
+                      continue
+                  for root in roots:
+                      if root not in stdlib and root not in OWN:
+                          offenders.append(f"{rel}: {root}")
+          if offenders:
+              print("NON_STDLIB_IMPORT:")
+              for entry in offenders:
+                  print(f"  {entry}")
+              raise SystemExit(1)
+          print("STDLIB_ONLY_OK")
+          PY
+
+      - name: The two new test modules pass with no third-party dependency installed
+        # Almost the strictest form of "the upgrade pulls no requirement": this runs BEFORE anything
+        # is installed, so a third-party import in either module fails here rather than being masked
+        # by an environment that happens to have the package.
+        run: |
+          python -m unittest tests.test_public_plugin_packaging tests.test_web_fallback -v \
+            2>&1 | tee upgrade-tests.log
+
+      - name: Install the project's own declared runtime dependency only
+        # The ONLY installation in this workflow, and it exists for the pre-existing suite, not for
+        # the upgrade. It resolves the project's own declared closure from pyproject metadata; no
+        # ad-hoc requirements file is pulled, and `requirements.lock` (which records the closure as
+        # installed, is NOT hash-pinned, and is therefore not an install recipe) is not used here.
+        run: |
+          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
+          python -m pip install -e .
+          python -m pip freeze | tee resolved-deps.txt
+
+      - name: Full unittest suite (raw log)
+        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v 2>&1 | tee full-unittest.log
+
+      - name: Negative — a mutated pack document must fail the identity binding
+        # FAIL-CLOSED: the failure MOTIVE must be the identity binding, not merely a non-zero exit.
+        # (a) the gate is green first, (b) a pack document is mutated, (c) the re-run must contain a
+        # real `FAIL:` line whose motive names the release-identity fields. A deleted module, an
+        # import error or a collection error exits non-zero too, and must NOT satisfy this step.
+        env:
+          PACK: dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+
+          # (a) green first — a gate that is already red must not be read as "the mutation was caught".
+          python -m unittest tests.test_s4ext_release_provenance 2>&1 | tee pre-mutation.log
+          grep -qE "^OK" pre-mutation.log
+
+          # (b) mutate the pack DOCUMENT: replace the release identity it stamps with a wrong one.
+          python - <<'PY'
+          from pathlib import Path
+          doc = Path("dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3/README_MOUNT.md")
+          text = doc.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+          mutated = text.replace("cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a", "0" * 40)
+          assert mutated != text, "the mutation fixture no longer matches the checked-in document"
+          doc.write_text(mutated, encoding="utf-8")
+          PY
+
+          set +e
+          python -m unittest tests.test_s4ext_release_provenance > mutation-run.log 2>&1
+          status=$?
+          set -e
+          git checkout -- "$PACK"
+          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain "$PACK")" ]; then
+            echo "RESTORE_FAILED: the mutated pack document was not restored" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          # (c) fail closed on every way this step could "pass" without exercising the binding.
+          if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "MUTATION_ACCEPTED: the identity binding passed a tampered pack document" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -qE "^FAIL:" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "GATE_NOT_EXERCISED: no real test failure (deleted module, import error or collection error)" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if grep -qE "ModuleNotFoundError|ImportError|No module named" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "GATE_NOT_EXERCISED: the run failed on an import/collection error, not on the binding" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -qE "does not carry|foreign release object" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "MUTATION_REFUSAL_MOTIVE_UNEXPECTED: the failure is not the identity binding" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -qE "release_tag_target|build_source_commit" mutation-run.log; then
+            echo "MUTATION_REFUSAL_MOTIVE_UNEXPECTED: the failure does not name the identity fields" >&2
+            tail -30 mutation-run.log >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "MUTATION_REFUSED_ON_IDENTITY_BINDING"
+
+      - name: Negative — the fallback builder must refuse a pack whose bytes drifted from MANIFEST.sha256
+        # Second half of the same binding, exercised through the upgrade's OWN tool: the byte
+        # binding (a member's bytes against MANIFEST.sha256) and the identity stamp it embeds.
+        env:
+          RELEASE_ID: v0.1.1-preview.3
+          RELEASE_COMMIT: cbf69756d7fc90fc1cdfb3a45a1cc42cc603cb0a
+          PACK: dist/mount/pipd-ls-sp-s4-chatgpt-mount-v0.1.1-preview.3
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          # A RELATIVE work dir under the workspace, so the shell and the tool resolve the SAME
+          # directory on any runner (no dependence on /tmp being shared).
+          WORK=".public-plugin-verify-work"
+          rm -rf "$WORK"
+          mkdir -p "$WORK"
+          trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
+
+          # green first: the untouched frozen pack must project into ONE DOC_MOUNT_ONLY document.
+          python tools/build_web_fallback.py \
+            --mount-pack "$PACK" \
+            --release-id "$RELEASE_ID" \
+            --release-commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
+            --out "$WORK/fallback.md" 2>&1 | tee fallback-green.log
+          grep -q "DOC_MOUNT_ONLY" fallback-green.log
+
+          # mutate a COPY's member bytes so they no longer match the pack's own MANIFEST.sha256.
+          mkdir -p "$WORK/evil"
+          cp -r "$PACK/." "$WORK/evil/"
+          printf '\n<!-- tampered: these bytes no longer match MANIFEST.sha256 -->\n' >> "$WORK/evil/SKILL.md"

+          set +e
+          python tools/build_web_fallback.py \
+            --mount-pack "$WORK/evil" \
+            --release-id "$RELEASE_ID" \
+            --release-commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
+            --out "$WORK/evil-fallback.md" > fallback-refusal.log 2>&1
+          status=$?
+          set -e
+          cat fallback-refusal.log
+
+          if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "MUTATION_ACCEPTED: the fallback builder accepted a pack whose bytes drifted" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if ! grep -q "REFUSED MANIFEST_DIGEST_MISMATCH" fallback-refusal.log; then
+            echo "MUTATION_REFUSAL_MOTIVE_UNEXPECTED: the refusal is not the byte binding (MANIFEST.sha256)" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "BYTE_DRIFT_REFUSED_ON_MANIFEST_BINDING"
+
+      - name: Upload raw logs
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@6f51ac03b9356f520e9adb1b1b7802705f340c2b  # v4.5.0
+        with:

+          path: |
+            resolved-deps.txt
+            upgrade-tests.log
+            full-unittest.log
+            pre-mutation.log
+            mutation-run.log
+            fallback-green.log
+            fallback-refusal.log
+          if-no-files-found: warn

+## Install
+
+Install is one of **two routes**, and [`docs/install/README.md`](docs/install/README.md) is the
+single source of truth for both:
+
+- **Web** — no public plugin directory listing exists yet, so the Web route today is the single
+  document `PIPD_WEB_FALLBACK.md` (built by `tools/build_web_fallback.py` from a frozen mount pack).
+  Its ceiling is **`DOC_MOUNT_ONLY`**: no Python CLI, no MCP, no repository write, no S4 acceptance.
+  A directory listing, once one is published and account-visible, is a *conditional* future route
+  and is not available today.
+- **Agent** — one copy-paste prompt,
+  [`docs/install/PIPD_AGENT_INSTALL_PROMPT.md`](docs/install/PIPD_AGENT_INSTALL_PROMPT.md), for the
+  four supported hosts (Hermes Agent, Codex Desktop (GUI), Codex CLI, Claude Code). Each host must
+  prove **real discovery** and an **8/8 effective load** of the eight skills; file presence is not
+  evidence, and a host that only copied files reports `NOT_VERIFIED`.
+
+Version pin, hashes, uninstall/rollback and how to report a failure live in
+[`docs/install/README.md`](docs/install/README.md).
